visualReview.cabinet: All six standing/crouched-wide actual camera views show outside room surfaces through narrow real slits, with intact door panels. This is constrained peeking, not an unobstructed panorama.
visualReview.cyclopse: Four actual frames progress from hidden activation to a partial silhouette, turning body, then forward arrival. Runtime records 6.117772 physical meters over7.963809 gameplay seconds before the roar; this frame sequence is not a video.
visualReview.music: Entry and reverse frames show six seats/score stands, upright piano with key grouping, wall instruments, a clearer aisle and fully wall-backed choir board. Close view shows raised black keys and score rest.
visualReview.signs: 2F approach shows text on a physical side-wall plaque, not across the open stair mouth. The reverse upstairs view uses the real player-floor red atmosphere and shows no floating entry label.
visualReview.recognition: Normal and softened UI-only transparent-target frames were inspected. The ordinary grain and reduced-motion edge-only states differ; these are not composites with the world camera, nor proof of perceived temporal intensity or audible mix.
visualReview.flashlight: The actual F-input case and HUD inspection confirm no persistent/toggle on/off text; the control hint and sound clip remain.

limits: Controlled actor/player placements for presentation and geometry fixtures are not a full human playthrough.
The original real-input seven-record route keeps all encounter owners and original movement speeds; one map-aware strategy is not all difficulty/survival strategies.
Actual active/pause main-output audio gate remains strict but does not separately certify new recognition-sting audibility or subjective mixing.
No new target-device manual launch/performance/listening result is claimed.
